articles.title: GTA 6 Launch Causes Massive Spike in Traffic for Internet Provider Xfinity
articles.summary: Internet provider Xfinity has reported a massive spike in traffic on Xbox consoles for GTA 6's New Zealand launch. Xfinity says it saw a jump in Xbox hardware traffic four times more than normal around the time GTA 6 became available in New Zealand.
body: However, these hours of early access have proven to be very lucrative for Xbox players. As a result, tons of footage for the game has been circulating on social media all day long. Major content creators also took advantage of the New Zealand trick, resulting in record-breaking viewership across platforms like Twitch. As of this afternoon, Twitch reported that tens of millions of watch hours had already been accumulated.

Right now, we still don't know how many copies of GTA 6 have sold, but we'll likely hear something by the end of this week or very early next week, depending on how quickly Rockstar wants to boast. This is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all-time, after all, and the official numbers will likely be eyewatering.

From a critical perspective, GTA 6 has received nothing but praise. IGN gave the game a 10 for its impeccable attention to detail and unprecedented depth, but we weren't alone in that analysis. The game is currently tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest rated game on Metacritic. It's also nominated for Game of the Year, in addition to seven other awards at The Game Awards.

The Ryzen 7 77535HS chip is equipped with onboard Radeon 680M graphics. As far as low-power onboard graphic solutions go, the 680M is an excellent gaming chip. In the past, iGPU gaming performance was just a meme, but not so anymore. The 680M is capable of running games like Fortnite and Minecraft at 1080p, and even more demanding games like Red Dead Redemption 2, Apex Legends, or even Cyberpunk with heavily modified settings.

articles.title: GTA 6’s Best Song Is A Nelly Furtado Cover From Azerbaijan
articles.summary: One of the mainstay features in Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto series is radio stations that can be listened to while driving in cars or, as in GTA 6, on the go if you acquire headphones. As a music-discovery vehicle, GTA: Vice City introduced me to many '80s classics across a variety of genres.
body: One of the radio stations you'll find in the game is Kaleidoscope FM. It features covers of very-well-known songs that are performed by artists from around the world. It's a fantastic hook for a radio station and delivers some of the catchiest and most-unexpected covers from artists that have a pretty low profile outside of their home countries.

The first song I heard on the station, and the one that remains my absolute favorite, is a cover of Nelly Furtado's "Say It Right" from Azerbaijani artists Alim Qasimov and Farghana Qasimova. The duo are known for performing Mugham, a type of music that blends poetry, melody, and improvisation. I had never heard of them before playing GTA 6, but the music instantly transported me to my youth listening to Qawwali, a type of music that is rooted in Islamic sufism.

articles.title: GTA 6 Doesn't Let Players Pick Up Prostitutes, but Rockstar Has a Logical Reason for It
articles.summary: Rockstar Games has revealed why they chose to forego the ability to pick up prostitutes in GTA 6. That's right — GTA 6 doesn't let you pick up ladies of the night when you're feeling lonely anymore.
body: Although Michael was a married man in GTA 5, he was not happily married, and spent most of the story dealing with the fact that his own wife cheated on him. Rockstar issued a statement to Shacknews about its decision to remove some features that were in previous GTA games, such as the ability to pick up prostitutes.

“GTA 6 is a game about a couple in a bind, lovers on the run," reads Rockstar's statement. "While we have taken a lot forward from previous GTA titles, everything we have implemented in 6 has been done to support the spirit of the story we wanted to tell, and the gameplay systems we wanted to expand upon - things like wanted system, the radio, robberies and car theft. Many aspects of previous titles are not present in GTA 6, but the elements we have we believe are all necessary and complementary to the feeling and motivations we wanted to emphasize as you play through Jason and Lucia's story.”

articles.title: The LEGO Poké Ball Set Gets Its First Discount Ahead of Amazon's Black Friday Sale
articles.summary: Amazon's Black Friday sale isn't going live until midnight tonight, but some of the best LEGO Pokémon deals have already been dropping early. That includes one of the most expensive sets in the entire theme, the giant LEGO Poké Ball.
body: This Poké Ball is more than just a really big LEGO display, it also houses some of the best minifigures and details from the franchise's 30-year history. The set's design is the classic spherical ball that operates on hinges so you can open it up to the scene inside. Inside the actual Poké Ball you get a miniature diorama recreating some iconic moments from the games. In the lid of the ball you'll see Professor Oak offering you a choice of three starter Pokémon, while the base features a Red minifigure battling a Picknicker's Eevee with Pikachu. At 2,386 pieces, this is an 18+ build that will take you a while to fully put together.

As far as LEGO Black Friday deals go, you're likely not going to see a better price than this any time soon. We expect Amazon to drop more discounts on sets tomorrow, but 20% off one of the most popular new sets of 2026 is going to be hard to beat at any retailer.

The official LEGO Black Friday sale doesn't actually start until actual Black Friday, which lands on November 27 this year. The LEGO Store will be hosting its annual Insider's Weekend event starting this Saturday, but that's more about loyalty points than straight discounts.

articles.title: KFC Announces GTA 6 Promo Where You Get A Disc-Shaped Piece Of Chicken
articles.summary: A lot of people are upset that they can't get GTA 6 on a physical disc, and KFC is now stepping up to do what Rockstar isn't. KFC Spain has announced a "Replace the Disc" campaign where customers can get a free disc-shaped piece of fried chicken when they bring in their GTA 6 box.
body: GTA 6 is sold at retailers like Best Buy, GameStop, and Target, but the box doesn't include a disc--instead, you get a code to unlock the game. GTA 6 owner Take-Two recently reported that 98% of its sales were digital, and while there will be some physical aspects to gaming forever, it's an increasingly small part of the business, Take-Two's boss has said.

This is not KFC's only promotion for GTA 6. KFC Australia is holding a fake funeral for a person named "Ann Alibi" in Australia's version of Miami on November 19. The fake funeral services are taking place in the middle of the day, per Ann's wishes, and so that people can have a "legitimate" reason to take the day off.

Numerous brands are latching onto GTA 6 to leverage the enormity of the game's release to promote their own stuff. McDonald's, for example, just announced a campaign to get your McNuggets or Big Mac delivered while you keep playing GTA 6. Even smaller, more regional brands-- including the Massachusetts-based brewery Tree House --have announced GTA 6 promos.

articles.title: GTA 6 Officially Cuts A Controversial Franchise Feature After 25 Years
articles.summary: You can do anything you want in a Grand Theft Auto game, but the franchise has historically been defined by a handful of specific mechanics. Steal a car. Shoot pedestrians. And for better or worse, soliciting a prostitute.
body: Prostitutes made their debut as NPCs in 2001 with the release of Grand Theft Auto 3. These characters, which appeared on the game's streets at night, could be solicited by the player for $100. Though the encounters were explicit in nature, the animations at the time only showed the vehicle bouncing suggestively.

The arguably tame mechanic became infamous for two primary reasons. Many fans approach GTA as a chaos simulator, so players sometimes target sex workers indiscriminately. It became a running joke, for lack of a better word, for GTA fans to sleep with and immediately kill the women they hired. Once dead, the NPCs would drop the money the player used to hire them.
points: You can do anything you want in a Grand Theft Auto game, but the franchise has historically been defined by a handful of specific mechanics.

articles.title: How Xbox’s Streaming Deal For GTA 6 Could Expand Its Marketshare By 30%
articles.summary: Microsoft and Take-Two recently announced a deal to allow people to stream Rockstar's GTA 6, and that significantly increases the game's addressable market on Xbox and means people can play the game for as little as $92.
body: This is according to a newly issued report from Ampere Analysis, which said the streaming deal could reach the estimated 10 million "active" Xbox One consoles out there and expand the total addressable market for GTA 6 on Xbox by 30%.
For anyone just catching up, Microsoft worked out a deal with Take-Two to allow GTA 6 to be streamed to an Xbox console--that could be an Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, or even an Xbox One.

There are some key things to know, including how the game streams from an Xbox Series S version of the game and your streaming experience will depend on the strength and consistency of your connection. A report from Digital Foundry said the Xbox Series S edition of GTA 6 struggles with its frame rate at some points, but that might not be an issue for everyone.

No such arrangement is in place for PlayStation, so the only way to stream GTA 6, at least right now, is on Xbox. Ampere said there are about 25 million PS4 consoles in the market that are still active, while Sony is the market leader for current-generation consoles with the PS5.

articles.title: The 10 greatest games to never get a GOTY nomination
articles.summary: The Game Awards announced its 2026 nominations yesterday, though not without controversy. Grand Theft Auto 6 — a game that isn't even out yet — leads the pack with eight nominations, including Game of the Year.
body: While there's a lot to be said about 2026's Game Awards snubs, some of the greatest games of all time never received a GOTY nomination. While the games below may have been nominated (or won) in other Game Awards categories, they never got their fair shot at Game of the Year honors.

Dark Souls 3 was a gorgeous, somber conclusion to FromSoftware's groundbreaking Dark Souls trilogy. By speeding up the pace of combat, Dark Souls 3 bridged Bloodborne and Elden Ring, streamlining an already iconic gameplay loop. To close out its trilogy, FromSoft proved it had complete mastery over the gameplay style it innovated years earlier.

Despite widespread acclaim, Dark Souls 3 was not nominated for Game of the Year in 2016, only getting a nod for Best RPG. Fans should take comfort in the fact that 2016 was an absolutely stacked year, though, with Overwatch, Doom, and Inside all competing for top honors. There's also the fact that very difficult games face an uphill battle in the GOTY race.

Grand Theft Auto 6 — a game that isn't even out yet — leads the pack with eight nominations, including Game of the Year.

articles.title: Not even Walton Goggins knows if Fallout will have a Season 4: 'if we get the opportunity to come back for season four, that would continue to honor how sacred this is to people'
articles.summary: I'm psyched for Fallout's third season whenever it comes out (Kyle MacLachlan says it could be May or June next year ), but I'd be perfectly happy if it had an ending and the show was done.
body: Season 3 has finished filming, but right now not even Walton Goggins, who plays The Ghoul, is sure what the future holds for Fallout's TV incarnation. Talking about how the show's maintaining the "subversive humor and the satirical kind of elements" it brought over from the games at an awards screening attended by GamesRadar, he said, "I feel confident that we've done that in season three, and if we get the opportunity to come back for season four, that would continue to honor how sacred this is to people. It's not something that we take lightly."

Goggins as we know doesn't play videogames himself. And co-star Aaron Moten has sworn off playing Fallout, leaving Ella Purnell the only actor to roll a Vault Dweller out of the headline trio. But despite that, Goggins is still aware of what the games mean to people.

"I mean, my son is a gamer. I see exactly how and why he plays games. I'm not a gamer at all, but the game of Fallout has been around for such a long time. It's been a shared experience between parents and their children and friends for such a long time, but it holds a very special place in their heart," Goggins said.

articles.title: Over an hour of new Total War: Warhammer 40,000 campaign footage shows gear customization, fleet mechanics, and emphasizes space marines are not always trusted and hard to replace
articles.summary: The last time we got a decent look at Total War: Warhammer 40,000 was the Gamescom build, which Fraser Brown called the highlight of his year. Since then Creative Assembly has continued iterating and a more recent build was subject to a friends-and-family playtest, then shown off in an "alpha…
body: Beginning 23 turns into an Ultramarines campaign, we got to see the battle for the Praevoss system, which has three conquerable planets in it—as well as a gas giant and a dead world that can't be fought over.

Each system in Total War: Warhammer 40,000 gets a separate narrative, a mini-campaign that plays out before you move on to the next system, taking some but not all of what you've built with you. That seems like an interesting way of dealing with the grand strategy problem of campaigns getting boring when you've painted half the map, but still have 100 turns before the end. Having a soft reset and facing different foes in a different theatre would keep a campaign feeling fresh.

In the Praevoss system the Ultramarines' objective is to liberate Imperial planets from an ork scourge. When the marines take a region, one of the options they have is to "scour the battlefield" in return for a big payout in Requisition, at the cost of raised Suspicion. Calling down a fleet bombardment to soften up orks ahead of the battle also raises Suspicion because there are still civilians in the area. Oops.

articles.title: PlayStation Network Outage Hits On GTA 6 Release Day Eve
articles.summary: What happens when a potential 250 million people try logging into a server at the same time? Problems, that's what. Thursday, Nov. 19 is the official release day for Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, and it appears Sony's platform, commonly known as PlayStation Network, is…
body: Whether you've seen codes like WS-116449-5, CE-34861-2, or WS-37505-0, they all point to the same thing: PlayStation's servers are facing serious strain.

GTA 6 is the follow-up to one of the most successful video games of all time, so the number of people trying to log in at once and download the game is likely massive. In the United States, it's the early afternoon — so many GTA fans probably just got off work and are all trying to do the same thing.

Though GTA 6 is not a multiplayer game that requires an online connection, players must download the title and its mandatory updates before they can enjoy it. This would have been the case even if GTA 6 had been printed on a disc — seemingly all major games require a day-one download for new patches or security reasons, like the recent PS5 jailbreak situation. This means that millions of people are trying to download hundreds of gigabytes of data at the same time, which was never going to end well.
There's no timeline for when PlayStation's servers might stabilize — and by extension, GTA 6 — but given the importance of this release, Sony are undoubtedly working on it.

articles.title: GTA 6's Japanese version only partially obscures male nudity by putting Jason in a thong, seemingly due to regional censorship
articles.summary: GTA 6 is slowly rolling out across the globe. The crime epic's already available to play in countries such as South Korea and New Zealand, but Japanese players are finding out that male nudity is only partially obscured by a thin black thong that covers Jason and the other men in Leonida.
body: Last week, we reported that GTA 6 might have been censored in Japan since the region's age rating board lacked any mention of the "sexual content" we knew it would include elsewhere. The Japanese version's install size was also notably smaller than other places in the world.

Now that GTA 6 is finally in the hands of players, we have a better idea of what was left out and/or covered up in Japan. Multiple social media accounts playing the game in Japan have reported that when you take main man Jason into the shower, his butt is only kinda covered up by a thong. At least in the version I played, Jason is usually fully naked while washing up.

Another social media post spots a different male NPC wearing a very similar black thong during a cutscene that normally has him laid bare in international versions of the game. I'm guessing all instances of male nudity might be obscured similarly in GTA 6's Japanese version.
